components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The main action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 23px; font: 700 0.74rem/1.4 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(5, 27, 18, 0.15); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b18000; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-gold { background: #ffe088; color: #241a00; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Strong secondary action on light pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 23px; background: #051b12; color: #fff; font: 700 0.74rem/1.4 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(5, 27, 18, 0.15); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b18000; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet action next to a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid #051b12; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 23px; background: transparent; color: #051b12; font: 700 0.74rem/1.4 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(5, 27, 18, 0.15); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b18000; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Date Field
components.description: Availability search field with an uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; font: 700 0.68rem Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #424844; } .ds-input { height: 50px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d0; background: #f6f3ee; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0 14px; color: #051b12; font: 1rem Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b18000; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Room Card
components.description: Room summary with photo area, demo badge and footer.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #eee9de; border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(5, 27, 18, 0.07); max-width: 360px; } .ds-card-photo { height: 160px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3026, #4c6358); position: relative; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 18px; background: rgba(252, 249, 244, 0.9); color: #051b12; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 12px; font: 700 0.7rem Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { padding: 28px; font: 15px/1.65 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; color: #424844; } .ds-card-body h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 600 1.7rem/1.15 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; color: #1c1c19; }

narrative.overview: The site feels like stepping onto the stone terrace of a manor at golden hour: deep canopy green, warm cream stone and a little lantern gold. It is calm and spacious, with large serif headlines, generous whitespace and photographs that do the atmospheric work. Nothing shouts. Gold is a small, warm light, not a fill. Components are soft and restrained: pill-shaped buttons and chips, softly rounded cards, gentle green-tinted shadows and a slight lift on hover. Glass panels (the floating navigation and the search panel) sit over the hero photograph like glass in a garden room. Every fictional room and demo reservation carries a visible label, and that label is part of the design, not a footnote.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green and warm cream, with gold used sparingly for accents and focus.
Playfair Display headlines over a quiet Manrope body.
Pill buttons, 28px cards, soft green shadows, light glass over photographs.
Calm density: one clear next step per section.

rules.name: The Lantern Rule
rules.body: Lantern Gold is a light, not a wall. Use it for one primary action per view, small accents and text on green; never for large backgrounds.

rules.name: The Brass on Cream Rule
rules.body: On light backgrounds, gold text and icons use Antique Brass, never Lantern Gold, so they stay readable.

rules.name: The One Serif Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is for headings and the brand name only. Labels, forms, chat messages and notes always use Manrope.

rules.name: The Green Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always tinted with Canopy Green, never pure black, so depth stays warm.

rules.name: The Lift on Hover Rule
rules.body: Buttons and the chat launcher lift 2–4px on hover. With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the lift and transitions are turned off.

dos: Do use only the colour tokens above; add a new token here before using a new colour.
Do keep one Lantern Gold primary action per view.
Do keep the "Fictional demo room" and "Demo reservation" labels visible wherever rooms or reservations appear.
Do keep the 3px Focus Amber outline on every interactive element.
Do turn off lifts and transitions under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't use Lantern Gold for text or icons on cream or white backgrounds.
Don't use pure black shadows or hard, dark drop shadows.
Don't use Playfair Display for labels, form fields or chat messages.
Don't add remote images or fonts; use the three photographs and the self-hosted fonts in frontend/assets/.
Don't show prices, ratings, awards or contact details as visual decoration.
